text: and Christians, we need to be careful don't think that everything that's done in the name of Jesus Christ supernaturally is necessarily from God test the spirits, John says for many spirits have gone forth they are not all from God ask this question, do they confess on John 4 , 1-3 that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh do they confess that Jesus Christ is Lord in their spirit thus we can identify and protect ourselves from the spirit of the antichrist and the spirit of the false prophet
